description: Tails Zeek conn.log and dns.log for first-seen external responders and anomalous DNS queries.
name: zeek_feed

signals.description: At least new_peer_threshold distinct external responders (id.resp_h) were first seen inside window_sec; already-seen peers do not count.
signals.name: zeek_new_external_peers

signals.description: A DNS query was at least query_length_threshold characters, had six or more labels, or used a TXT, NULL, KEY or ANY qtype.
signals.name: zeek_dns_anomaly
